title: RAG Retrieval
text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves external evidence before generation. Retrieval quality depends on chunking, query formulation, embeddings, lexical search and reranking.

title: Faithfulness
text: Faithfulness measures whether an answer is supported by the supplied evidence. Unsupported claims increase hallucination risk.

title: Reranking
text: A reranker reorders candidate documents using a more precise relevance model after initial retrieval. Hybrid retrieval can combine lexical and semantic signals.

title: Observability
text: AI observability records traces, latency, token usage, model calls, retrieval results, tool calls and errors so failures can be diagnosed.

title: Evaluation
text: Reliable LLM evaluation uses representative datasets and metrics such as context relevance, answer relevance, faithfulness, recall at k and mean reciprocal rank.

title: Guardrails
text: Guardrails can validate inputs and outputs for policy, safety, privacy or structured-format requirements before an application returns a result.
